slides.title: A Planned Path From Interest to Depth
bullets: A sequence of content pieces across formats, depth and channels
Mirrors the personalization at the heart of omnichannel
Moves an HCP from initial interest to a nuanced understanding

slides.title: Different HCPs, Different Starting Points
bullets: HCPs sit at different points of knowledge and need
Forcing identical content on everyone wastes their time
A specialist and a newcomer need different starting material
Both can still value the same advanced content later

slides.title: Three Layers of Depth
bullets: Introductory content sparks interest and sets context
Intermediate content covers mechanisms, evidence, comparisons
Advanced content serves publications, expert webinars, direct MSL talks
HCPs can enter or exit the journey at any layer

slides.title: Coherence Across Every Piece
bullets: All pieces must rest on the same approved evidence
The core scientific message stays consistent throughout
Contradictions erode HCP trust in the source
Each piece must also stand alone, since order isn't guaranteed

slides.title: Recommend the Piece, Report the Gap
bullets: Suggest the content that matches the HCP's real interest level
Flag when a conversation reveals a gap the journey doesn't cover
Closes the loop between field listening and content design

takeaway.title: A scientific content journey lets each HCP go as deep as their need requires
bullets: Content layers from introductory to advanced, not one-size-fits-all
Every piece must share the same evidence and stand on its own
MSLs both recommend content and flag missing pieces to content teams
